prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Tin (주석) itself — the sovereign of the Tin Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cute, bright-eyed sweetness; fair skin; oval face; large eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; small button nose; small bow lips; storm-grey eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Body and hair: petite, small-framed build; a short tousled pixie cut with side-swept bangs; soft pewter-silver hair with a satin sheen.
Expression: a faint wistful smile, soft eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: tin: soft, bright silvery-white metal; melted with copper it made bronze and opened the Bronze Age; bend a bar and it creaks a faint crackling 'tin cry'; left in deep cold it slowly crumbles into grey powder, the tin pest; tin cans and tinplate toy soldiers, satin pewter cups, the tall pipes of church organs and the solder that joins small things together; soft, musical and quietly binding.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. soft satin pewter-silver full-body armor of interlocking plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet by raised mirror-bright solder-bead seams, plate edges ribbed in rows like organ pipes, a back unit of tall tuned organ-pipe resonators rising above the shoulders, thin warm amber heater lines along every joint keeping the tin from the cold; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where the exposure below allows, dense visible seams and joints. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: soft satin pewter silver, bright tinplate white, storm grey, a touch of bronze gold.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2240, a polar resonance city under the bright polar summer sun: forests of tuned tin-alloy pipe towers singing in the polar wind like a giant organ, warm heated domes that keep the tin from crumbling into grey powder in the cold, mirror-bright solder seams running across the ice.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Sn) and atomic number (50) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.

observations: 1024×1536 verified; full body with both hands visible.
World-specific costume and pewter-silver hair present.
Sn and 50 appear within scene or costume.
